newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ukraine says debut foreign bond to be in yen.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine says debut foreign bond to be in yen.

text.p: Ukraine's first foreign bond issue, planned for September on the Japanese market, will be denominated in yen, and a second European market bond will be in dollars or marks, Deputy Finance Minister Mykhailo Honcharuk said on Tuesday.

"It will be in yen," Honcharuk told Reuters, speaking about the first bond during an investor conference. Honcharuk said Ukraine was discussing the second bond with lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell. "It may be in dollars or Deutschemarks," he said.
The second bond is planned for September or October on the European market.
Ukraine still has to obtain a rating and has not announced volumes for either bond.
Central bank chairman Viktor Yushchenko said previously Ukraine wanted to raise $400 to $900 million on foreign bond markets this year, partly to finance the budget deficit.
